patch_description: Structural redesign around the proven 0.62-scoring two-stage architecture (adaptive Kalman → robust Savitzky-Golay), reorganized into a modular coarse-to-fine pipeline and incorporating the recommended co-sweep of window widening and recency steepness: SG window widened to 2W+7 with a recency tilt of e^-1.2 applied jointly, plus a locally-adaptive hysteresis snap stage to cut spurious slope reversals. The recency-weighted convolution (mode="valid", preserving the length contract and efficiency 1.00) compensates the group delay of the wider SG window, buying extra smoothness at near-zero lag cost. Modules: NoiseEstimator, AdaptiveKalmanStage, RobustSavgolStage, RecencyConvolveStage, LocalHysteresisSnap.
